      "section": "mod-tome/data/talents/psionic/dreaming.lua",
      "source": "Slip into a lucid dream.  While in this state, you are considered sleeping, but can still act, are immune to insomnia, inflict %d%% more damage to targets under the effects of Insomnia, and your Physical, Mental, and Spell saves are increased by %d.\n\t\tNote that being asleep may make you more vulnerable to certain effects (such as Inner Demons, Night Terror, and Waking Nightmare).\n\t\tThe saving throw bonuses scale with your Mindpower.",
      "source_tag": "tformat",
      "special": null,
      "target": "你进入清晰梦境。在此状态下，你虽然处于睡眠状态但仍可以行动，并且对失眠免疫，对失眠状态下的目标附加 %d%% 伤害，同时，你的物理、法术和精神豁免增加 %d 点。\n\t\t注意：处于睡眠状态可能使你更容易受到某些效果的影响（例如心魔、梦魇降临和清醒梦魇）。\n\t\t受精神强度影响，豁免增益效果按比例加成。"
    },
    {
      "args_order": null,
      "component": "tome",
      "entry_id": "78825f7b286f949eb9ad1cd97f4362d4195021a1663a7c971d66dc584f2ee5ed",
      "notes": "Lite review batch 0373 host-confirmed edit",
      "section": "mod-tome/data/talents/misc/races.lua",
      "source": "While Highers are not meant to rule other humans - and show no particular will to do so - they are frequently called to higher duties.\n\t\tTheir nature grants them better senses than other humans.\n\t\tIncrease blindness immunity by %d%%, maximum sight range by %d, and increases existing infravision, and heightened senses range by %d.\n\t\tAt talent level 5, each time you hit a target you gain telepathy to all similar creatures in radius 15 for 5 turns.",
      "source_tag": "tformat",
      "special": null,
      "target": "虽然高等人类并非生来就要统治他人——他们也没有特别的意愿去那样做——但是他们经常承担更高的义务。\n\t\t他们的天性赋予他们比其他人类更敏锐的感官。\n\t\t增加 %d%% 目盲免疫，最大视野范围提高 %d 格，夜视及感应范围提高 %d 格。\n\t\t技能等级 5 时，每次你命中目标，你将获得 15 格范围内同类型生物感知能力，持续 5 回合。"
    },
    {
      "args_order": null,
      "component": "tome",

      "notes": "Lite review batch 0373 host-confirmed edit",
      "section": "mod-tome/data/talents/spells/golemancy.lua",
      "source": "Teleport to your golem, while your golem teleports to your location. Your foes will be confused, and those that were attacking you will have a %d%% chance to target your golem instead.",
      "source_tag": "tformat",
      "special": null,
      "target": "使用此技能后，你和傀儡将会交换位置。之前以你为目标的敌人有 %d%% 概率转而以傀儡为目标。"
